description: Diagnostic daemon to investigate why write_service has heartbeat age 1h31m (stale). Must: (1) use write_service :8772 for state only, never direct DB. (2) check DuckDB accessibility by querying information_schema.tables. (3) verify port 8772 is listening. (4) test write throughput: POST a small payload to /write with wait=True and measure round-trip. (5) log findings to LOG_DIR/write_service_diagnostic.log. (6) output structured dict: {service: str, port_listening: bool, db_accessible: bool, write_latency_ms: float, last_heartbeat: str, status: str}. (7) do NOT attempt to restart — diagnostic only. (8) write_service is protected — this is a companion diagnostic module.
